Change the future of food

Make an impact on one of the largest industries in the world.

Join Tastewise

Where food & beverage meets AI innovation

Passionate about food and eager to be part of a fast-paced SaaS startup? At Tastewise, we live and breathe food — it’s in our DNA.

Our leading AI-powered consumer intelligence platform is the secret ingredient behind global food and beverage brands like Nestle, Pepsi, & Campbell’s, enabling them to place their consumers at the center of every decision.

With insights from billions of data points, we empower clients to create, market, and sell their products faster and more successfully.

We work at the forefront of food and beverage innovation — and we have fun doing it! Join us.

Our values

We believe the future is ours to create and start each day ready to work hard, together, to channel passion into purpose.

Change is our recipe: Be uncomfortably excited

Change is the status quo. Lets adapt to it and embrace it while developing our agility and resilience. Faster is better than perfect. Do not fear making mistakes.

Get cooking: Get it done

Say yes. Make it yours, then make it happen. Be the chef and take ownership. Be accountable. No BS, no nonsense.

Supersize it: Think big, aim high

“Feeding the actions and decisions that feed the world” sounds big, doesn’t it? Ambition, an entrepreneurial mindset, and creativity are superfoods we consume every day.

Eat together: Help the team win

We feed on collaboration. Our commitment to one another allows us to go above and beyond. We are winners.

No artificial flavors: Be true

Be honest, authentic, transparent. Build with constructive criticism. Deliver the brutal truth in an un-brutal way. Great collaboration always comes with communication.
